findings.message: This file is the designated evidence point for PLAN task t13 ('Measure queue resource and durability costs') and LLD testStrategy item 'queue-resource-and-fsync-cost-measurement', but its callees list is completely empty — no calls at all, not even a test-registration call — in contrast to scripts/__tests__/project-memory-s2-qualification.test.ts (calls fresh/crashProof) or packages/project-memory/src/__tests__/queue-cost.test.ts (calls nativeTest). This indicates the file likely does not actually register or execute the required p50/p95 acceptance-latency, cold-recovery, physical-byte and RSS/heap measurement evidence that t13's acceptance checks and the LLD's nonFunctional.performance section mandate before OD-02 can be considered closed.
